  [IsArtinianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))]
  (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hpzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (P i) = 0)
  (hp : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) ↑(P i) = 0) :
  let Q := MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H);
  have q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H));
  ∃ N,
    (N.mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = fun i => ↑(P i)) ∧
      ∃ M,
        LinearStudy.Annihilates (KaehlerDifferential.ideal K Q) M.det ∧
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' K) M.det = Matrix.det fun i j => q ↑((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i))) ∧
            (LinearStudy.pairingRightReduction (LinearStudy.powerSeriesQuotientAugmentation H hzero)) M.det = q N.det

      ∃ u,

            1 ⊗ₜ[B]
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (H i))

LinearStudy.powerSeries_diagonal_differe.formalType:
LinearStudy.powerSeries_diagonal_difference.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3}
  {ι : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
  (u v : MvPowerSeries ι R →+* A) (π : A →+* B) (hC : ∀ (c : R), u (MvPowerSeries.C c) = v (MvPowerSeries.C c))
  (hX : ∀ (i : ι), π (u (MvPowerSeries.X i)) = π (v (MvPowerSeries.X i)))
  (hu : ∀ (i : ι), IsNilpotent (u (MvPowerSeries.X i))) (hv : ∀ (i : ι), IsNilpotent (v (MvPowerSeries.X i)))
  (H : MvPowerSeries ι R) :
  ∃ a,
    u H - v H = ∑ i, a i * (u (MvPowerSeries.X i) - v (MvPowerSeries.X i)) ∧
      ∀ (i : ι), π (a i) = π (u ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv i) H))

LinearStudy.powerSeries_diagonal_jacobia.formalType:
LinearStudy.powerSeries_diagonal_jacobian_matrix.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3}
  {ι : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
  (u v : MvPowerSeries ι R →+* A) (π : A →+* B) (hC : ∀ (c : R), u (MvPowerSeries.C c) = v (MvPowerSeries.C c))
  (hX : ∀ (i : ι), π (u (MvPowerSeries.X i)) = π (v (MvPowerSeries.X i)))
  (hu : ∀ (i : ι), IsNilpotent (u (MvPowerSeries.X i))) (hv : ∀ (i : ι), IsNilpotent (v (MvPowerSeries.X i)))
  (H : ι → MvPowerSeries ι R) (hH : ∀ (i : ι), u (H i) = v (H i)) :
  ∃ M,
    LinearStudy.Annihilates (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => u (MvPowerSeries.X i) - v (MvPowerSeries.X i))) M.det ∧
      (M.map ⇑π = fun i j => π (u ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (H i)))) ∧
        π M.det = Matrix.det fun i j => π (u ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (H i)))

LinearStudy.powerSeries_coefficientDeter.formalType:

  [IsArtinianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))] :
  ∃ M,
    M.mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = H ∧
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) M.det ≠ 0 ∧
        Submodule.annihilator
            (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) (MvPowerSeries.X i))) =

scope: The exact local Lemma31Goal over complex finite-variable power series is PROVED by lemma31_complete, including original relative Jacobian annihilator generation and the Artinian, maximal-ideal, nonzero and socle-generation conclusions for every permitted arbitrary parameter lift. A new equation presentation, base automorphism, finite free action and perfect pairing are constructed, not assumed. All earlier audited helpers retain their exact parameter scopes. The global Linearity Theorem, its Scheme-to-coordinate comparison, Bertini/generic fiber geometry, global Euler-Jacobi relation, uniform Serre/duality lifting and geometric Bezout estimate remain UNPROVED. The actual arbitrary-parameter quotient reduction to complex numbers, finite-dimensionality, local evaluation formula and normalized perfect multiplication pairing are constructed from the original hypotheses. Actual derivations and first-order congruences give the fiber determinant unit factor and transfer of nonvanishing and annihilation. These local functionals are not claimed to be the globally compatible Grothendieck residues; geometric charts supplying the first-order data and global Euler-Jacobi vanishing remain open.

nodes.formalType:
LinearStudy.finiteFlat_residueTensor_jacobian_scalar_socle.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] {r n : ℕ}
  (H : Fin (n + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K))
  (hH : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K)) (List.ofFn H))
  [Module.Finite (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K)
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K) ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))]
  [Module.Flat (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K)
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K) ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))] :
  let B := MvPowerSeries (Fin (r + 1)) K;
  let A := MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H);
  let k := B ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B;
  let C := TensorProduct B k A;
  ∀ (x : C),
    LinearStudy.Annihilates (nilradical C) x →
      ∃ u,
        x =
          u •
            1 ⊗ₜ[B]
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (H i))

LinearStudy.lemma31_local_evaluation_formula {r c : ℕ} (H : Fin c → LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c) (hr : 0 < r)
  (hc : 0 < c) (hH : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c) (List.ofFn H))
  [Module.Finite (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r) (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H)]
  [Module.Flat (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r) (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H)]
  (q : LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H →ₐ[LinearStudy.ParameterRing r] LinearStudy.ParameterRing r)
  (hq : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H))
  (tau : Fin r → LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H)
  (htau : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => q (tau i)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r)) :
  have J := Ideal.span (Set.range tau);
  have delta := (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H);
  ∃ rho,
    rho delta = 1 ∧
      ∀ (h : LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H),
        rho ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J) h * delta) = MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (q h)

LinearStudy.fiber_jacobian_unit_factor.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [CommRing K]
  [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (D : ι → Derivation K R R) (I : Ideal R) (u : Rˣ) (H p : ι → R)
